prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Companion Selection Centered Layout Redesign: Redesign the pick friend screen using a clean centered layout to focus attention on companion choice options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "centered"}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray Quick Reference Screen: Add a dedicated post-setup overview screen explaining how to toggle and manage the pet from the desktop tray icon.
   config: {"new_tray_quick_reference": {"headline": "Managing Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Use the system tray icon anytime to show, hide, or customize your companion on screen.", "layout": "card"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_tray_quick_reference"]}
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Split Layout Redesign: Rebuild the waiting screen layout into a modern split view showing status on one side and rendering progress on the other.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "show_progress": true}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Grid Layout Redesign: Redesign the intro story screen into a clean structured grid layout presenting onboarding highlights clearly.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "grid"}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Safety Sign-In Hint: Add a clear sign-in hint explaining that authenticating protects account pets from being reset or lost on desktop relaunch.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in to permanently save your pet data and prevent accidental resets when relaunching."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Status Wait Headline: Update the waiting screen headline to explicitly state desktop companion asset generation progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Building Your Desktop Companion Asset...", "show_time_estimate": true}}
6: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Headline Refresh: Update the adoption certificate screen headline to reinforce ownership and completion momentum.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Your Companion Adoption Record is Confirmed"}}
7: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Control Overview Screen: Insert a concise final setup screen demonstrating keyboard and tray controls to show or hide the pet on screen.
   config: {"new_visibility_overview": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Visibility Controls", "body": "Easily show, hide, or bring your pet to the front using desktop context options.", "layout": "spotlight"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_visibility_overview"]}
8: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Resolution Guidance Hint: Provide a photo upload hint emphasizing clear lighting and high resolution for accurate companion generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use a well-lit, front-facing photo to ensure best companion rendering accuracy."}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Journey Path Selection Headline Refresh: Update the choose path screen headline to clearly frame the choice of desktop companion experience.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Preferred Companion Desktop Experience"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning pick_friend to a centered layout maintains all required functionality and complies with all base rules.
Adding a post-setup desktop tray quick reference screen following home_intro is permitted under Rule 4 and preserves all onboarding steps.
Split layout redesign for the waiting screen retains the screen's core job and complies with all rules.
Grid layout redesign for the story screen preserves its introductory function and satisfies all rules.
Adding an account persistence hint on the sign-in screen is informative and complies with fair design rules.
Updating the waiting screen status text and enabling a real time estimate complies with base rules.
Updating the headline copy on the adoption certificate maintains all required screen jobs and rule requirements.
Adding a visibility control overview screen following home_intro is allowed and preserves all onboarding steps.
Adding resolution and lighting guidance hint to photo upload is fair and maintains screen function.
Updating the choose_path screen headline preserves path selection and adheres to all base rules.
